description.summary: Protocol for requesting activation of surfaces

protocol.description: Vendored from wayland-protocols (staging/xdg-activation). A client asks for a token while it has the user's attention and hands it to whatever it launches (XDG_ACTIVATION_TOKEN); that program activates its surface with it.

interface.name: xdg_activation_v1
interface.description: A global interface used for informing the compositor about applications being activated or started, or for applications to request to be activated.

interface.name: xdg_activation_token_v1
interface.description: An object for setting up a token and receiving a token handle that can be passed as an activation token to another client.
